title: esgb-gw-distance-checks: symbolic and numerical checks of the gravitational-wave luminosity distance on the luminal branch of Einstein-scalar-Gauss-Bonnet cosmology
description:
Verification scripts and derivation notes for the tensor sector of Einstein-scalar-Gauss-Bonnet (EsGB) cosmology on the luminal branch (c_T = 1). The scripts check symbolically, in two independent ways, the quadratic tensor action (G_T = 1 + 8 H df/dt, F_T = 1 + 8 d2f/dt2) and the Hamiltonian constraint 3 H^2 (1 + 8 H df/dt) = rho_tot, and check numerically the distance ratio d_GW/d_EM = sqrt(G_T(0)/G_T(z)) by integrating the wave equation. A further script quantifies how well the standard (Xi_0, n) and c_M templates reproduce that ratio.

This record is a set of checks, not a research article. The distance ratio on the luminal branch is the result of Linder (arXiv:2108.11526), and the EsGB tensor sector with c_T = 1 is also analysed by Fier et al. (arXiv:2503.01975); the scripts reproduce those relations independently. Numerical work uses a LambdaCDM background as a test approximation. The derivation notes are written in Indonesian.

Version 1.1.0 adds two preliminary estimates: a cosmology-only ceiling on the coupling from a literature nucleosynthesis bound, and a one-parameter Fisher estimate of the number of Einstein Telescope sirens needed to separate a non-minimal coupling template or the luminal Gauss-Bonnet ratio from general relativity.
